description: FIRST EPSS exploit-prediction scores for up to 100 CVEs: probability of exploitation in the next 30 days, percentile rank and a simple band, for the latest model run or a past date. Complements /v1/cve-lookup and /v1/cisa-kev for vulnerability prioritisation. Price: $0.01 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: GET https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/epss-score
